title: chore(pm-dispatch): an underived ceiling order goes back before a thread opens; a card thread checks the tier it is served
body:

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCxiFE11rsKwyNffJZKYqJs)_

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jSQkebczqNyjnNrLRH

Fixes #36358

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Rule-change: yes

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感：这是车队内部规则的补充，新增五条你在决策卡上选了「五条都写」的规则，并按你上午的答复改掉了派单工具里那句过时的档位提示。
- 为什么做：上午两张派单写了最高档却没人核对；现在开线程前先查档位那一行，线程开工先核对实际拿到的档，协调者、区线程、总监的取值也补齐了。
- 出错会怎样：席位或协调者可能误退一张派单，或线程多报一次档位，耽误几分钟；撤回本次合并即可恢复原文，不影响产品和用户数据。
- 要你做什么：这个 PR 新增了车队规则，需要你批准合并。

## What changes

The second and last pull request of the card: items 11-15, which the maintainer approved as a set (Q13 of ruling record 7076315104 on the card: the decision card 「定一下：五条新增规则要不要写进技能」, chosen 「五条都写」), the two answers recorded in ruling record 7077400471 (「1 同意、2 同意」), and the three nits the contract review of the first pull request left for this one.

**The five rule lines (Q13)**

- Item 11, `references/coordinator.md` 四, one sentence: before a card thread opens, the coordinator reads the order's `model:` line. If it names the ceiling and the same line carries neither a `--tier` MANDATORY line nor a `reason:` that names a ruling (a comment id, or a standing tier order's id and time), the order goes back to the seat and no thread opens.
- Item 12, two halves. `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`: a card thread's first step reads the tier it is served (`readings-session.md`) and compares it with the order; a mismatch in either direction is reported to the seat before any work, and the first report carries the served tier. `references/dispatch-runbook.md` (card-thread section): the seat writes that tier into the claim's `Container & model` line, and on a mismatch the thread does not start until the seat decides.
- Item 13, the home (`references/execution-duties.md`, 定档): the coordinator session runs at the default tier, effort `high`.
- Item 14, the home: an area thread runs at the default tier, effort `high`; a card with a MANDATORY line is built by an isolated ceiling sub-agent or in its own card thread. The area-thread value leaves the card-thread line and gets its own line.
- Item 15, the home: the director seat's effort is `high`; its tier stays the maintainer's per-project choice.

**Ruling record 7077400471**

- Item 1, no text change: a card that only declares a contract change (`Clause-②: yes`) keeps its L2 review at the default tier. `contract-review.md` (its declaration row) already says so, and the home's review-tier line says that tier lives only in that file. The first two heads added a line to the home that restated it; the contract review found its wording could be read wider than the rule (S1 of 7078357171), and the seat chose to drop the line, so the third commit removes it.
- Item 2, `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, one printed sentence, text only. With no path-derived mandate the tool printed "The tier stays the PM's per-card judgment call (floor · default · ceiling)", which the home's first two lines contradict. It now prints "The tier stays below the ceiling: with no mandate the PM picks floor or default per card, and a ceiling build takes a path-derived mandate or the maintainer's explicit order (floor · default · ceiling)". No judgment logic, derivation row or constant changes. The opening words and the closing parenthesis are kept because the tool's self-test finds the line by them, and the sentence says "path-derived mandate" because the same self-test refuses the upper-case word in the no-mandate rendering. `dispatch-gates.data.mjs` is not touched.

**Nits carried from the first pull request's contract review (N8-N10)**, all in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈升级与决策〉

- N8: on the "a ruling is put only through the director seat and decision threads" line the exception now follows the route, so it no longer reads as qualifying "always decided by the maintainer".
- N9: the "a question for the maintainer first goes through a decision thread" line carries the same exception as its neighbours.
- N10: the exception names seats and triage. A dev still reports `needs_decision` and never asks directly, as `os-dev.md` has said throughout; the earlier wording listed dev among those who may ask.

## Why

Two orders on 2026-11-22 named the ceiling tier for the build with no derivation, both threads were in fact served the default tier, and nobody read either the order or the served tier. The first pull request made the rule readable in one place; these lines add the two reads that would have caught it (the coordinator before the thread opens, the thread at its first step) and fill the role values the home had no ruled value for (the coordinator session, the area thread's tier, the director's effort).

## Tests

No test file changes. The one script line is a printed sentence. `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (the tool's self-test battery, 2252 cases) exits 0 with it, and `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier` on a `packages/spec/src/**` path prints the new sentence under "no path-derived mandate". The first wording of the sentence failed one case of that battery ("the no-mandate rendering claims no mandate") at the first pushed head; the second commit rewords it.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's acceptance for this pull request: an order line `model: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER (reason: spec contract surface; Clause-② yes)` is returned before a thread opens. The written step in `coordinator.md` 四 covers it: that `reason:` names no ruling.
- No value is written outside the home: `coordinator.md`, `os-dev.md` and `dispatch-runbook.md` gain procedure only.
- No skill line carries a card number, a comment id or a dated quotation.
- N10 is a reading of the maintainer's Q14 words (addendum 7076338827), which do not say who asks. Keeping the dev rule strict is the narrower reading; say so if seats' devs should be allowed the direct question too.

## Verification

**Bytes** (`node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, exit 0 at the head). Every row below is raised by exactly the bytes of the new text, and each row comment quotes its ruling id.

| File | main | head | ceiling row | ruling |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `references/coordinator.md` | 4230 | 4427 | 4230 → 4427 (+197) | 7076315104, Q13 (item 11) |
| `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` | 38846 | 38986 | 38848 → 38986 (+138; 2 bytes were headroom) | 7076315104, Q13 (item 12) |
| `references/dispatch-runbook.md` | 20344 | 20483 | 20344 → 20483 (+139) | 7076315104, Q13 (item 12) |
| `references/execution-duties.md` | 22158 | 22316 | 22158 → 22316 (+158) | 7076315104, Q13 (items 13-15) |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` | 33881 | 33919 | 33881 → 33919 (+38) | 7076338827, Q14 (N9 and N10; N8 is byte-neutral). The row comment says the naming of seats and triage is a reading, not the ruling's words |

**Gates** (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` over the seven changed files derives 71 commands). The local record is in three parts, stated here rather than hidden:

- 69 commands ran at the first pushed head `fd54f8fb4` and exited 0.
- The other two were not green there and were re-run alone at the second head `e116b15bf`: `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (exit 1 at the first head, one case of 2252, fixed by the second commit; exit 0) and `pnpm check:i18n-coverage` (exit 3 at the first head, a missing local build of the workspace CLI and the example apps, nothing in this diff; exit 0 after that build). `--ran` over that record: 71 derived, 71 run, 0 NOT MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- The third commit (the review fix) touches `references/execution-duties.md` and `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`. The 41 commands derived for those two files, the self-test battery among them, were run again at the final head `36cce5462`: all exit 0, and `--ran` reads 41 derived, 41 run, 0 NOT MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

The other 30 commands of the 71 were not run again locally after the first head; CI at `36cce5462` runs the final tree.

`node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` at the final head: merges cleanly into `origin/main`, verdict clean.

**Read first** (by risk)

1. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, the one changed line: text only, inside the `!mandatory` branch of the tier printer.
2. `references/coordinator.md` 四, the new second line: what makes the coordinator return an order.
3. `references/execution-duties.md`, 定档: the three role lines (director, coordinator, area thread).

**Two-minute check**: run `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --tier packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts` and expect the second line of the tier block to start "The tier stays below the ceiling".

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No `packages/spec` change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (None added.)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (Markdown, one data table, one string literal.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. (The card's second pull request, as the card orders; the first one merged.)
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (Nothing publishes; `skip-changeset`.)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (The 维护者速读 section is the maintainer's Chinese summary.)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
